question: When you say close a session, what should happen to running work and its thread?

options.label: Stop and archive
options.tradeoff: Tidies immediately; interrupts unfinished work but keeps history and files.

options.label: Finish then archive
options.tradeoff: Lets work finish; the thread closes later.

options.label: Stop only
options.tradeoff: Keeps the thread visible for later.

options.label: Choose each time
options.tradeoff: More control at the cost of another click.

settled: /new takes no required arguments and guides folder selection.
/new creates a clean idle thread and does not run a model.
The first user message in the new thread starts work.
Natural-language session management stays within the category.
Control-center remains the entry point; workers threads are sessions.
One shared default system across all three categories.

behavior.natural_language_close: same behavior within the current category
